name: Paracetamol
uses: Relieves mild to moderate pain and reduces fever.
warnings: Do not exceed the maximum daily dose
Check other medicines for hidden paracetamol content
interactions: Warfarin (increased bleeding risk with long-term use)
storageInstructions: Store below 25°C in a dry place, away from direct sunlight.

name: Ibuprofen
warnings: Use caution with kidney disease or ulcers
storageInstructions: Store at room temperature, keep tablets in original blister pack.

name: Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS)
uses: Restores fluids and electrolytes lost from diarrhea or vomiting.
dosage: Dissolve 1 sachet in 1L clean water; sip frequently through the day.
warnings: Use exact water quantity on the label
alternatives: Homemade sugar-salt solution (as a stopgap only)
interactions: No significant interactions with common medicines
storageInstructions: Store sachets in a cool, dry place. Use mixed solution within 24 hours.

name: Azithromycin
uses: Treats certain bacterial infections, including respiratory and skin infections.
dosage: As prescribed — typically 500mg on day 1, then 250mg for 4 days.
warnings: Only use with a valid prescription
Inform your doctor of heart rhythm conditions
interactions: Antacids (reduced absorption — space doses 2 hours apart)
storageInstructions: Store below 30°C. Keep suspension refrigerated if reconstituted.

name: Cetirizine
uses: Relieves allergy symptoms like sneezing, itching, and runny nose.
warnings: Avoid driving until you know how it affects you
Use lower dose if you have kidney issues
storageInstructions: Store at room temperature away from moisture.
